seo.title: Abo turi bo
seo.description: Menya Pi Global GCV Alliance — intego yacu, indangagaciro zacu z'ibanze, ubuyobozi bwacu, n'icyerekezo cyacu ku isi mu bucuruzi, ubuhanga bushya, n'iterambere risangiwe muri Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Amerika.

hero.title: Abo turi bo muri Pi Global GCV Alliance
hero.subtitle: Kubaka ubukungu bw'ubucuruzi ku isi bwuzuye ubutabera kandi bwitabira bose muri Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Amerika binyuze mu Gaciro ry'Impuzamahanga Ryemejwe (GCV).

mission.title: Intego yacu
mission.paragraph1: Pi Global GCV Alliance yiyemeje guha abacuruzi, abatanga serivisi, n'inzego ibikoresho n'ubufasha bw'umuryango bakenera kugira ngo bacuruze mu buryo bw'ubutabera ku isoko ry'isi rikura buri munsi.
mission.paragraph2: Twemera ko Agaciro k'Impuzamahanga Ryemejwe kagaragaza impinduka ikomeye mu buryo ubucuruzi bugenwa igiciro — igipimo kimwe, kigaragara, kandi kihagaze buri munsi umunyamuryango wese yizera, aho kwishingikiriza ku giciro gihinduka buri gihe.
mission.paragraph3: Binyuze mu burezi, kuburana ku bw'inyungu z'abandi, no kubaka umuryango, dufasha kubaka ejo hazaza h'ubucuruzi bwuzuye ubutabera buhuza ibihugu bine.

items.title: Umuryango mbere na mbere
items.desc: Dushyira imbere ibyifuzo n'ijwi ry'umuryango w'abanyamuryango bacu muri byose dukora.

items.title: Agaciro k'ubutabera
items.desc: Duharanira igipimo cy'ivunjisha kigaragara kandi kihagaze burundu, kirinda buri wese ufatanya mu bucuruzi.

items.title: Uburezi
items.desc: Duha abanyamuryango n'abacuruzi ubushobozi binyuze mu bikoresho by'uburezi n'ubufasha bunoze.

items.title: Ubumwe ku isi
items.desc: Twubaka ibiraro hagati ya Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Amerika kugira ngo tuzane urusobe rumwe rw'ubucuruzi.

gcv.title: Ni iki Agaciro k'Impuzamahanga Ryemejwe (GCV)?
gcv.disclaimerStrong: GCV ni intego y'igiciro yatanzwe n'umuryango, ntabwo ari igipimo cyemewe na Pi Network.
gcv.disclaimerRest: Ntabwo cyemejwe na Pi Core Team cyangwa ngo kigenzurwe kuri isoko iryo ari ryo ryose. Igiciro nyacyo cya Pi ku isoko riguzwa n'abandi ni nto cyane — ni amasenti make, atari amayobera y'ibihumbi n'ibihumbi by'amadolari.
gcv.paragraph1Before: Agaciro k'Impuzamahanga Ryemejwe (GCV) ni igipimo Ihuriro ryumvikanyeho hamwe n'umuryango wose, gitanga
gcv.paragraph1After: — umubare uvuye ku ihame rya matematike π (3.14159) hakurwaho akadomo k'igice mu myanya ine ijya iburyo. Ibicuruzwa na serivisi biri kuri GCV Market bishyirwaho igiciro muri Dolari z'Amerika kandi bikagaragazwa bihinduwe muri Pi hakurikijwe iyi ntego y'umuryango.
gcv.paragraph2: Bitandukanye n'igiciro gishyirwaho ku isoko ry'imigabane, GCV ni igipimo cy'icyerekezo, cyumvikanyweho n'ihuriro ryose hagati y'ababanjirije abandi — ntabwo ari agaciro k'isoko. Kigaragaza icyo abacuruzi n'abanyamuryango bumvikanyeho hagati yabo, ntabwo ari igiciro Pi ifite ku isoko iryo ari ryo ryose.
principles: Intego imwe, yumvikanyweho n'umuryango, ikoreshwa mu buryo buhoraho kuri Market yose
Kugaragara mu gushyiraho ibiciro no mu buryo bw'igurana
Kurinda uburiganya bw'isoko no ubucuruzi butemewe
Ihame rimwe, risangiwe muri buri karere k'ihuriro
gcv.paragraph3: Ku banyamuryango bo muri Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Amerika, GCV igaragaza icyifuzo gisangiwe cyo gucuruza mu buryo bw'ubutabera kandi buteganyijwe — hifashishijwe igipimo kimwe, gikoreshwa mu buryo buhoraho, ahantu hose mu Ihuriro.

doris.name: Doris Yin
doris.role: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Umuryango wa GCV ku Isi
doris.bio1: Doris Yin ni Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Umuryango wa GCV ku Isi kandi ni we washinze GCV Movement of Africa.
doris.bio2: Ubutumwa bwe nyamukuru — "Kubaka Umusingi Ukomeye, Inkingi y'Ejo Hazaza Heza" — ni ibanze ry'imyumvire y'uburezi no kubaka umuryango mu Ihuriro muri buri karere.

olivier.name: Olivier Ndatimana
olivier.role: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wa GCV ku Isi
olivier.tagline: Umuyobozi w’imiryango ku rwego rw’isi • Rwiyemezamirimo • Umuhuzabikorwa mpuzamahanga
olivier.bio1: Olivier Ndatimana ni Umunyarwanda uyobora imiryango, akaba rwiyemezamirimo n’umuhuzabikorwa mpuzamahanga. Afite uburambe mu iterambere ry’imiryango, ubuyobozi, itumanaho, guteza imbere ubucuruzi n’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga.
olivier.founderBio: Uwashinze Africa GCV Movement, ahuza ibikorwa byo muri Afurika n’umuryango mpuzamahanga binyuze mu guhuza imiryango, guteza imbere ubuyobozi n’ubufatanye.

gcv.title: Umuryango wa GCV
gcv.description: Nka Muyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wa GCV ku Isi n’uwashinze Africa GCV Movement, Olivier yibanda ku guhuza imiryango ku rwego mpuzamahanga, guteza imbere ubuyobozi, itumanaho, gutanga raporo no gushimangira ubufatanye hagati y’abayobozi, ambasaderi n’imiryango ya GCV muri Afurika no mu tundi turere.
gcv.experience: Amaze imyaka myinshi muri GCV, aho yakoze inshingano zitandukanye mu buyobozi no mu miryango. Yagize uruhare mu guteza imbere no guhuza ibikorwa muri Afurika no kubihuza n’umuryango mpuzamahanga.

pi.title: Umuryango wa Pi Network
pi.description: Olivier agira uruhare mu kubaka umuryango, itumanaho no kwigisha, ahuza aba Pioneers bo mu bihugu bitandukanye. Asangira amakuru, ashishikariza abantu ubufatanye no kugira uruhare mu bikorwa, kandi afasha aba Pioneers gusobanukirwa impinduka n’amahirwe biri muri Pi.
pi.distinction: Ibi bikorwa by’umuryango ntibivuze ko akorera Pi Network Core Team cyangwa ko afite umwanya wemewe mu buyobozi bwayo. Umwanya nk’uwo wakenera kwemezwa ku mugaragaro na Pi Network.

business.title: Kigali Hot Market Ltd
business.sectors: Ubwikorezi • Gutumiza no kohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga • Ubucuruzi bwo kuri interineti
business.description: Kigali Hot Market Ltd (KHM-LTD) ikora mu bwikorezi, gutumiza no kohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga, no mu bucuruzi bwo kuri interineti. Ikigo giteza imbere ubucuruzi, gitanga serivisi z’ubucuruzi, gihuza abakiriya n’abatanga ibicuruzwa na serivisi, kandi gifasha mu kubona amahirwe y’ubucuruzi.

approach.title: Uburyo ayobora
approach.description: Olivier ashyira imbere ubumwe, ubufatanye burangwa n’amahoro, kubahana, gukorera hamwe n’icyerekezo cy’igihe kirekire. Yizera ko itandukaniro mu bitekerezo, inkomoko cyangwa inyungu z’ibihugu ridakwiye kubuza abantu gukorera hamwe ku ntego rusange. Uburyo ayobora buhuza abantu, bufungura inzira z’itumanaho, bushishikariza abantu kuzuza inshingano kandi bwubaka imiryango irambye.

vision.title: Icyerekezo mpuzamahanga
vision.description: Icyerekezo cye ni uguhuza Afurika n’umuryango w’isi, gufungura amahirwe y’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga, gushyigikira kwihangira imirimo n’iterambere ry’imiryango. Yizera ko iterambere rirambye rishingira ku bufatanye, ubuyobozi bwuzuza inshingano, ikoranabuhanga, kwihangira imirimo n’imiryango ikomeye.

regionsSection.title: Ibihugu bine, Ihuriro rimwe
regionsSection.description: Pi Global GCV Alliance yubatswe hakurikijwe Intumwa n'Abashinze b'uturere muri Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Amerika, buri wese ayobora umutwe muri karere ke.

hero.title: Itsinda Nkuru rya GCV
hero.subtitle: Abashinze, abayobozi, intumwa, n'inzobere babaka umutwe wa GCV muri Afurika no ku isi.

seo.description: Menya Intumwa za GCV zihagarariye Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Amerika — abayobozi b'imbere mu murongo ba Pi Global GCV Alliance.

hero.subtitle: Amasosiyete, inzego, n'imiryango bo mu bihugu bine byemeranyijwe n'ihame rya GCV kandi bubaka ubukungu bushingiye kuri Pi.

seo.description: Reba urutonde rw'abacuruzi ba GCV — amasosiyete ya Afurika yakira Pi ku gipimo cya GCV mu biribwa, ikoranabuhanga, uburezi, ubuzima, n'ibindi.

hero.title: Urutonde rw'Abacuruzi
hero.subtitle: Menya amasosiyete ya Afurika yakira Pi ku gipimo cya GCV. Uhereye ku bagurisha ibiribwa kugeza ku masosiyete y'ikoranabuhanga — gura, urye, kandi ukore ubucuruzi muri Pi.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha umucuruzi hakurikijwe izina, ubwoko, cyangwa igihugu…
